name: Sample Career
shortDescription: A short demo simulation to test the app.

name: Software Engineer
shortDescription: Build and fix software at an Indian startup, with vague tickets, code reviews and Friday-evening bugs included.

name: Doctor (MBBS)
shortDescription: Live a week as a junior resident: long shifts, tough calls and families who need answers.

name: Chartered Accountant
shortDescription: From articleship to filing deadlines: audits, taxes and clients who hand you a shoebox of receipts.

name: Civil Services (IAS)
shortDescription: Try the aspirant years and a first posting as an SDM, where floods, files and phone calls all arrive at once.

name: Content Creator
shortDescription: Script, shoot, post and hope: the real numbers behind building an audience.

name: AI/ML Engineer
shortDescription: Messy data, models that break in production and managers who think AI can do anything.

name: Lawyer
shortDescription: Midnight drafting, adjourned hearings and a senior who takes credit for your argument.

name: UI/UX Designer
shortDescription: Design screens people actually use, then defend them from 'make the logo bigger'.

name: Cybersecurity Analyst
shortDescription: 2:47am, 400 alerts and one of them is real.

name: Digital Marketer
shortDescription: Run ad campaigns where every rupee is tracked and algorithms change overnight.
